exposure: intrauterine gauze compress combined B-Lynch uterine compression suture
cohort: Five patients who experienced postpartum hemorrhage due to placenta previa accreta between January 2009 and March 2013 and were unresponsive to medical therapy.
finding: The intrauterine gauze compress combined B-Lynch uterine compression suture was successful in managing postpartum hemorrhage in patients with placenta previa accreta, with no patients requiring hysterectomy or experiencing complications.
